scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @graphql/contracts --filter @graphql/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @graphql/contracts --filter @graphql/api dev
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck"
scripts.lint: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --no-bail --no-sort --if-present lint"
scripts.test: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test"
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs --timeout-ms 9000000 -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && node scripts/test-integration.mjs"
scripts.test:acceptance: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/contracts build && corepack pnpm --filter @graphql/api test:acceptance"
